initiatives.title: Onpair : String Encoding
initiatives.summary: Short version: it trades encode speed for ratio and decode speed — it decodes faster than every compressed alternative measured and wins ratio on most text-heavy columns, but its training pass makes encode substantially slower. Author: Prateek Gaur Suggested by :  Julien Le Dem, Russell Spitzer, Andrew Lamb Other file formats that support it : Vortex, anyone else? We measure it head-to-head against FSST (the string encoding currently proposed for Parquet), and against the general-purpose block compressors zstd -1 and lz4, on the three axes that matter for a columnar format: compression ratio, decompression speed (with per-row random access), and compression speed.
key_points:
Thanks Prateek,

I also wanted to explicitly mention here on the mailing list again how
similar I think FSST and OnPair

initiatives.title: Add VECTOR repetition level for fixed-size-list serializatio
initiatives.summary: Only supporting a single level of nesting within an optional group like in your embedding example might be a reasonable limitation to start with, and would likely cover the majority of use cases. Today, every such column round-trips through the three-level LIST encoding: each row pays for repetition and definition levels that describe a shape that is, by construction, already known. initiatives.title: Open Questions for ALP Specification
initiatives.summary: The discussion highlights two main concerns regarding the C++ implementation of ALP: the hard-coded vector size and the handling of unsigned math in Java. Participants are debating whether to keep the vector size fixed for simplicity or to make it configurable, while also ensuring proper cross-compatibility with Java and Rust implementations.
key_points: Hard-coded vector size may simplify testing
Need to ensure Java handles unsigned math correctly

initiatives.title: Location for VariantJsonParser
initiatives.summary: The discussion revolves around where to place the VariantJsonParser for JSON-to-Variant conversion. Two options are proposed: keeping it in the parquet-variant module or moving it to parquet-jackson, with various implications for dependencies and integration.

initiatives.title: Discussion on Dictionary Bit Width Zero
initiatives.summary: The discussion revolves around the implications of allowing a dictionary bit width of zero in encoding, which could lead to potential denial of service attacks through compression bombs. Participants are considering the need for testing against such scenarios and whether to include guidelines in the specification.
key_points: Bit width zero can create compression bombs
Need for testing files to prevent denial of service

initiatives.title: FSST Dependency Approach Discussion
initiatives.summary: The team is discussing two approaches for handling the FSST dependency for Parquet: using CMake to pull it as an external dependency or vendoring the code by copying necessary files into the repository. Opinions vary, with some favoring vendoring for lower maintenance, while others express concerns about potential future updates and maintenance challenges.
key_points: CMake adds external dependency
Vendoring may simplify maintenance

initiatives.title: Extending encryption support in parquet-cli
initiatives.summary: The discussion focuses on adding encryption support to parquet-cli, which currently lacks full functionality for handling encrypted Parquet files. Arnav plans to extend support to all commands and is seeking input on any existing reasons for the limited implementation.
key_points: Current support is limited to 3 out of 19 commands
Arnav is planning to implement full support

initiatives.title: Feature Addition Requirements for Parquet
initiatives.summary: A draft document outlining the process for adding new features to the Parquet format has been shared for community feedback. The document aims to clarify requirements for incorporating new encodings and improvements while ensuring security and compatibility.
key_points: Draft document shared for feedback
Focus on security and compatibility in feature additions

initiatives.title: Bloom Filter Properties Discussion
initiatives.summary: A discussion has arisen regarding the behavior of bloom filter properties in the parquet-java implementation, specifically when the false positive probability (fpp) is defined without a specified number of distinct values (ndv). The community is considering whether to continue ignoring the fpp, return an error, or use a default value in such cases.
key_points: Ambiguity in bloom filter behavior
Options for handling fpp without ndv

initiatives.summary: A discussion has been initiated regarding the addition of a new numeric logical type, DECFLOAT, to the Parquet specification. initiatives.title: Enable Page Index and Size Stats by Default
initiatives.summary: The C++ Parquet implementation in Apache Arrow is proposing to enable Page Index and Size Statistics features by default, which are currently disabled. Benchmark results indicate that enabling these features incurs acceptable performance penalties, and a PR has been opened for this change ahead of the Apache Arrow 20.0.0 release.
key_points: Benchmark results support enabling features by default
No objections received for the proposed change

initiatives.title: Open Variant Shredding Issues
initiatives.summary: The discussion focuses on the shredding specification for the Variant type, which aims to optimize storage by extracting fields into individual columns. Participants are debating whether normalization should be a requirement or left to writer implementations, emphasizing the importance of maintaining data integrity in the storage layer.
key_points: Shredding optimizes storage by separating fields
Normalization should be optional for writer implementations

initiatives.title: Deprecate or Drop Parquet-Scala Module
initiatives.summary: There is a discussion among developers about the future of the `parquet-scala` module, which has seen little usage and minimal updates over the years. Many participants support retiring or removing the module due to its lack of contributions and the availability of alternatives for users.
key_points: Limited usage of parquet-scala module
Support for removing the module

initiatives.title: ByteStreamSplitDecoder Issue with Nulls
initiatives.summary: The ByteStreamSplitDecoder is malfunctioning due to the encoder not writing 'num_values' in the Page payload for BYTE_STREAM_SPLIT. This leads to decoding issues, particularly with DATA_PAGE_V1, where the absence of statistics prevents accurate reading of values.
key_points: Encoder fails to write num_values
Decoding issues with DATA_PAGE_V1
